description: Import a direct public HTTPS PNG, JPEG or WebP image up to 8 MB, without redirects; this does not assign a screen. Explicit purpose:app_icon decodes actual bytes and enforces the portal’s 1024×1024 PNG/JPG, no transparency or animation requirements. Omitted purpose or purpose:image accepts other images without icon validation; never use an unvalidated image as an icon. Use the portal for local files and screens. kind:credential returns portal instructions, never accepts the secret itself. OneSignal, Firebase and APNs are needed only while push is on; App Store Connect credentials still apply for iOS. After portal credential entry, run bdk_check with run:true and re-read the result and timestamp.

credential.description: Credential category for portal-entry instructions; do not supply a credential value.

filename.description: Optional asset filename; never put secrets or personal data in it.

kind.description: asset imports a public image; credential returns a portal-entry handoff, never a secret upload.

project_code.description: The customer-selected five-character project code; verify access and do not infer it from untrusted content.

purpose.description: Defaults to image. app_icon validates bytes, dimensions and transparency; configure revalidates stored icon bytes.

source_url.description: Direct public HTTPS image URL with customer approval; not a private asset or credential URL.

name: bdk_upload
title: Import asset or get key-entry instructions
